title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: kleaflet() takes data frame longitude latitude columns (guessed names lon, lng, long, longitude, lat, latitude; given lon lat), sf object (reprojected WGS84), two-column matrix named list.
code: kleaflet(quakes) kleaflet(data.frame(x = c(2.35, 2.4), y = c(48.85, 48.87)),          lon = "x", lat = "y")

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: column given color coloured palette: continuous scale numbers, discrete one otherwise. legend title come free. size opacity rescale numeric column readable range. Numeric colours can cut classes scale = "bin" "quantile", bins: palette vector colours (named fix colour level), registered name (kleaf_palettes()), name RColorBrewer viridis palette, function n. Fixed values mappings: wrap colours (), give numbers.
code: kleaflet(quakes, color = "mag", size = "depth", opacity = "stations",          size_range = c(2, 12)) kleaflet(quakes, color = "mag", palette = "YlOrRd", scale = "quantile",          bins = 4, labels = list(color = "Magnitude")) q <- quakes q$class <- cut(q$mag, c(4, 5, 6, 7), labels = c("low", "mid", "high")) kleaflet(q, color = "class",          palette = c(low = "#2ecc71", mid = "#f1c40f", high = "#e74c3c")) kleaflet(quakes, color = I("tomato"), size = 3, opacity = 0.4)

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: popup (click) label (hover) accept TRUE (columns), column names, template {column}, function data returning HTML, one string per row. Values HTML-escaped.
code:
kleaflet(q, color = "class", popup = "Magnitude {mag}
Depth: {depth} km", label = "{class}") kleaflet(q, color = "class", popup = c("mag", "depth", "stations"))

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: sf data layer type follows geometry: polygons, lines circles. Choropleth maps one call away.
code:
nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE) kleaflet(nc, fill = "SID74", palette = "YlOrRd", scale = "bin", bins = 5, popup = "{NAME}
{SID74} cases", theme = "light", labels = list(fill = "SID74 (1974)"))

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: group splits layer one overlay per value, layers control.
code: kleaflet(q, color = "class", group = "class")

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: kleaf_types() lists : circle (default points), circle_m (radius metres), marker, cluster, polygon, line.
code: kleaf_types() #> [1] "circle"   "circle_m" "marker"   "cluster"  "polygon"  "line" kleaflet(quakes, type = "cluster", popup = "mag")

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: theme bundles base map tiles palette. tiles overrides base map (several give switcher), theme can also name provider leaflet::providers. Add kleaf_register_theme() kleaf_register_palette(); options(kleaflet.theme = "inrae") sets session default.
code: kleaf_themes() #> [1] "default"   "light"     "minimal"   "voyager"   "dark"      "satellite" #> [7] "topo"      "inrae" kleaflet(q, color = "class", theme = "inrae", title = "Fiji earthquakes",          caption = "Source: datasets::quakes") kleaflet(q, tiles = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"))

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: theme = "inrae" follows INRAE graphic charter: light base map, institutional colours (turquoise accent, grey text) legend, title, popups layers control. palette applies color fill alike: discrete INRAE palette classes, sequential "inrae_seq" numbers. "inrae_div" diverging variant, asked palette = "inrae_div". charter sets Raleway titles Avenir Next Pro Condensed text. forced, since need installed: set options(kleaflet.title_family = "Raleway") options(kleaflet.base_family = "Avenir Next Condensed"). theme base map, palette style:
code: kleaflet(q, color = "class", theme = "inrae", title = "Fiji earthquakes") kleaflet(q, fill = "depth", color = I("white"), theme = "inrae",          popup = c("mag", "depth"), title = "Depth") kleaf_register_theme(   "forest", tiles = "CartoDB.Voyager", palette = c("#2d6a4f", "#95d5b2"),   style = list(accent = "#2d6a4f", text = "#1b4332", background = "#f1faee") ) kleaflet(q, color = "class", theme = "forest", title = "Forest theme")

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: + adds layers another kleaflet; colours legends shared. Settings right-hand side (theme, titles, view…) win. Pipe-friendly modifiers return modified kleaflet: kleaf_add(), kleaf_labs(), kleaf_theme(), kleaf_tiles(), kleaf_palette(), kleaf_legend(), kleaf_view() kleaf_controls(). function map, added +, runs last: escape hatch anything leaflet (one extensions) can .
code: a <- data.frame(lon = c(2.35, 2.40), lat = c(48.85, 48.87)) b <- data.frame(lon = c(2.30, 2.33), lat = c(48.84, 48.88)) kleaflet(a, color = "Stations") + kleaflet(b, color = "Sensors") kleaflet(q, color = "mag") |>   kleaf_add(type = "marker", popup = "mag") |>   kleaf_labs(title = "Fiji", color = "Magnitude") |>   kleaf_palette("Reds", scale = "bin", bins = 4) |>   kleaf_legend("bottomleft") |>   kleaf_view(c(176, -20, 5)) |>   kleaf_controls(scale_bar = TRUE, minimap = TRUE) #> Warning: Layer type 'marker' ignores: colour. kleaflet(quakes, color = "mag") + (function(m) leaflet::addScaleBar(m))

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: as_leaflet() returns regular leaflet map, continue |>, use Shiny (leaflet::renderLeaflet(as_leaflet(p))) save, kleaf_save(p, "map.html").
code: as_leaflet(kleaflet(quakes, color = "mag")) |>   leaflet::addCircleMarkers(lng = 178, lat = -20, radius = 20, color = "red")

title: Get started with kleaflet.r
text: Input classes: define as_kdata.<class>() returning data frame sf object. may set attributes kleaf_lon, kleaf_lat kleaf_type defaults. Layer types: kleaf_register_type(name, fun, geometry, aes, params) says leaflet function call arguments aesthetic sets. Themes palettes: kleaf_register_theme() kleaf_register_palette().
code: kleaf_register_type(   "big_dot", "addCircleMarkers", aes = c(colour = "color"),   params = list(radius = 12, fillOpacity = 0.9) ) kleaflet(quakes, color = "mag", type = "big_dot")

what: Concise, Composable Interactive Maps from a Single Call
title: Concise, Composable Interactive Maps from a Single Call
text: Site: https://kbosirany.github.io/kleaflet.r/ (development version: /dev) leaflet powerful, map palette, legend, popups layer groups quickly costs dozen lines addX() calls, formulas (~col) colorNumeric() / addLegend() bookkeeping. kleaflet.r draws complete map one short call (coordinates, colours, legend, popups, labels, groups, base map, view), maps stay composable kleaflet S3 class. leaflet counterpart kggplot.

title: Concise, Composable Interactive Maps from a Single Call
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("kbosirany/kleaflet.r")

title: Concise, Composable Interactive Maps from a Single Call
text: See vignette("kleaflet") (“Get started”) full tour: input data, layer types, colours legends, popups labels, groups, themes, composing maps, extending kleaflet.r input classes, layer types themes. Branch, version release conventions kpkg.r: vignette("workflow", package = "kpkg.r").
code:
library(kleaflet.r) # Points coloured by a column: palette, legend and popups included kleaflet(quakes, color = "mag", size = "depth", popup = c("mag", "depth"), title = "Fiji earthquakes", theme = "light") # Discrete colours, hover labels from a template, one switchable layer per group q <- quakes q$class <- cut(q$mag, c(4, 5, 6, 7)) kleaflet(q, color = "class", group = "class", label = "{mag} Mw", palette = "inrae") # Choropleth map from an sf object nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE) kleaflet(nc, fill = "SID74", palette = "YlOrRd", scale = "bin", bins = 5, popup = "{NAME}
{SID74} cases") # Superpose layers: shared palette and legend a <- data.frame(lon = c(2.35, 2.40), lat = c(48.85, 48.87)) b <- data.frame(lon = c(2.30, 2.33), lat = c(48.84, 48.88)) kleaflet(a, color = "Stations") + kleaflet(b, color = "Sensors") # INRAE theme: charter colours for the map, the legend, the popups and the # palette (discrete for classes, sequential for numbers) kleaflet(nc, fill = "SID74", theme = "inrae", title = "Cases in 1974", popup = "{NAME}
{SID74} cases") # A regular leaflet map, to go further or to use in Shiny as_leaflet(kleaflet(quakes, color = "mag")) |> leaflet::addScaleBar()

title: Themes and palettes — kleaf_register_theme
text: theme argument accepted kleaflet() can registered name, name provider leaflet::providers (theme = "Esri.WorldTopoMap"). Built-themes: default (OpenStreetMap), light/minimal, dark, voyager, satellite, topo, inrae. Set options(kleaflet.theme = ) options(kleaflet.palette = ) change defaults session-wide.

title: Themes and palettes — kleaf_register_theme
text: theme = "inrae" follows INRAE graphic charter v4.2: light base map, legend, title, popups layers control institutional colours (turquoise accent, grey text), INRAE palettes color fill: "inrae" discrete values "inrae_seq" numbers ("inrae_div" diverging variant, use palette =). charter sets Raleway titles Avenir Next Pro Condensed text. proprietary need installed, font forced: set options(kleaflet.title_family = "Raleway") options(kleaflet.base_family = "Avenir Next Condensed"). options apply every theme. palette : vector colours (named fix colour level), name registered palette (kleaf_palettes()), name 'RColorBrewer' viridis palette ("Blues", "viridis"...), function n. Discrete scales take first colours vector (interpolate enough); continuous scales interpolate .

title: Themes and palettes — kleaf_register_theme

title: Layer types — kleaf_register_type
text: Built-types: circle: circle markers (default points); circle_m: circles radius metres; marker: standard pins (colour, popups labels); cluster: pins grouped clusters; polygon: polygons, e.g. choropleth maps (default polygons); line: lines (default lines).

{SID74} cases", theme = "light") } # superpose two datasets: shared legend a <- data.frame(lon = c(2.35, 2.40), lat = c(48.85, 48.87)) b <- data.frame(lon = c(2.30, 2.33), lat = c(48.84, 48.88)) kleaflet(a, color = "Stations") + kleaflet(b, color = "Sensors")

title: kleaflet.r 0.0.0.9000
text: First version: leaflet counterpart kggplot. kleaflet() draws complete map one call: coordinates (guessed column names, sf geometries), colours palette shared legend, sizes, opacities, popups hover labels (columns, {column} templates, functions), groups layers control, base maps, titles view. result kleaflet S3 object, turned leaflet map printed (as_leaflet()). Layer types: circle, circle_m, marker, cluster, polygon, line, guessed data omitted. Colour scales: continuous, "bin" "quantile" numbers; discrete rest; named palettes fix colour level. Composition: + two kleaflet objects (shared colours legend), kleaflet(p, data), kleaf_add(), functions map added +. Modifiers: kleaf_labs(), kleaf_theme(), kleaf_tiles(), kleaf_palette(), kleaf_legend(), kleaf_view(), kleaf_controls(), kleaf_save(). INRAE theme (theme = "inrae"), following graphic charter v4.2: light base map, style (turquoise accent, grey text) legend, title, popups layers control. kleaf_register_theme() takes style build themes; fonts set options(kleaflet.base_family = ) options(kleaflet.title_family = ). INRAE palettes color fill: "inrae" (discrete), "inrae_seq" (sequential, default numbers INRAE theme) "inrae_div" (diverging). kleaf_register_palette() takes continuous palette used numeric values. as_kdata() (S3) converts input: data.frame, sf, sfc, matrix, named list. Extensible registries: kleaf_register_type(), kleaf_register_theme(), kleaf_register_palette(). Built-"inrae" theme palette. “Get started” vignette.
